purpose: Reference discovery and evidence-level control, not incorporation of documents or certification.

evidence_levels.OFFICIAL_TEXT_REVIEWED: Relevant source text was inspected selectively; obtain the exact task-specific clause before applying.
evidence_levels.OFFICIAL_METADATA_VERIFIED: Official title, edition, catalogue entry or listed scope metadata verified; detailed rules not available from this record.
evidence_levels.PROJECT_DOCUMENT: User-supplied project text; authority and incorporation must be verified per task.
evidence_levels.UNAVAILABLE: Required source not accessible; request lawful copy or relevant excerpt.

sources.title: Standard Method of Measurement for Civil Engineering Works
sources.publisher: Hong Kong Government / Civil Engineering and Development Department
sources.edition_or_series: 1992 Edition; consolidated Rev 10 incorporating Corrigendum 1/2011, September 2011
sources.intended_scope: Adopted civil measurement, especially Section 2 GI and clauses 2.27-2.30 instrument installation; other items only where relevant
sources.applicability_caveat: Official catalogue and source text reviewed selectively. The electronic version is for reference; issued hard copy/corrigenda prevail over electronic inconsistencies. Not UK CESMM.

sources.title: General Specification for Civil Engineering Works
sources.edition_or_series: 2020 Edition; Volume 1 Rev 8 including Amendment 3/2026 dated 23 July 2026
sources.intended_scope: Section 7 Part 2 GI, Part 4 geotechnical grouting and Part 6 instrumentation, where applicable
sources.applicability_caveat: Current contents and selected relevant passages inspected. Record adopted amendments. Technical scope is not itself a separately payable bill item; do not apply grouting rules to all improvement methods.

sources.title: Project Administration Handbook for Civil Engineering Works
sources.edition_or_series: 2024 Edition, rolling chapters: Ch4 27 July 2026; Ch5 21 September 2026; Ch6 20 March 2026; Ch7 15 July 2025; Ch9 23 December 2024
sources.intended_scope: Applicable public civil project estimating, tendering, administration and measurement workflows
sources.applicability_caveat: Chapters 4 and 7 passages and catalogue reviewed. Record exact chapter revision; departmental guidance is not automatically a private contract term. Ch7 begins from GCC1999; use NEC guidance for NEC.

sources.title: Standard Contract Documents: General Conditions of Contract and associated forms
sources.edition_or_series: Building/Civil/E&M/Design-and-Build 1999; Term Building 2004; Term Civil 2002 listed
sources.intended_scope: Government GCC family selection and document retrieval
sources.applicability_caveat: Catalogue verified, not all clauses. Use signed contract edition, SCC/ACC, amendments and precedence provisions; do not hardcode notice/payment rules.

sources.title: NEC Engineering and Construction Contract documents and Practice Notes for Public Works Projects in Hong Kong
sources.edition_or_series: Practice Notes Volumes 0 and 1 September 2026; NEC ECC HK Edition ACC complete set July 2026
sources.intended_scope: Hong Kong public works NEC guidance and supplementary documents
sources.applicability_caveat: Page also has a separate NEC4 branch. Select actual contract family/edition/options and incorporated ACC. Guidance does not replace the commercial NEC base contract.

sources.title: NEC Engineering and Construction Contract Hong Kong Edition
sources.edition_or_series: July 2023 base edition; project-adopted amendments to be recorded
sources.intended_scope: Base NEC ECC Hong Kong Edition where adopted
sources.applicability_caveat: Commercial text not reviewed. Require authorised base contract, option, Contract Data, Scope and ACC for clause-level advice. TSC and PSC are different contract families.

sources.title: Civil Engineering Works Tender Price Index
sources.edition_or_series: Live series; scope governed by official explanatory notes and DEVB TC(W) 6/2017
sources.intended_scope: Suitable civil tender-price normalisation for estimates
sources.applicability_caveat: Scope excludes architectural work, E&M installations, ground investigation, soft landscaping, ancillary works and term contracts. Read applicability before selecting.

sources.title: Index Numbers of the Costs of Labour and Materials Used in Public Sector Construction Projects
sources.edition_or_series: Separate rebased series, including April 2003 and April 2021; material-specific series may differ
sources.intended_scope: Specified labour/material input-cost series and contractual price adjustment evidence
sources.applicability_caveat: Record series ID, trade/material, base, observation period, provisional/revised status and contract formula. Do not mix index bases or replace the contractual basket with a tender-price index.

sources.title: Construction Industry Security of Payment Ordinance (Cap. 652): implementation and scope
sources.publisher: Development Bureau; Construction Industry Council; Hong Kong e-Legislation
sources.edition_or_series: Full operation 28 August 2025; verify current statute, scope and transitional provisions
sources.intended_scope: Screening potentially covered payment claims and contract mechanisms
sources.applicability_caveat: Official implementation and CIC scope text reviewed; do not treat every construction contract as covered. Check dates, public/private definitions, contract category/value, exclusions and subcontract chain; retrieve current statute for exact legal duties.

sources.title: Security of Payment Provisions in Public Works Contracts: Technical Circular (Works) 6/2021 update
sources.intended_scope: Transition and applicability of contractual SOPP in public works
sources.applicability_caveat: Keep contractual SOPP separate from statutory Cap. 652. Check exact acceptance dates, applicable amendment and contract incorporation; do not replace older contracts wholesale.

sources.title: Guide to Site Investigation (Geoguide 2)
sources.edition_or_series: 2017 Version, consolidated 18 December 2017; original September 1987 with GG2/01/2017
sources.intended_scope: Investigation planning and technical scope for associated instrument boreholes
sources.applicability_caveat: Metadata and stated purpose verified. Retrieve actual technical clauses before application; not a method of payment.

sources.title: Guide to Rock and Soil Descriptions (Geoguide 3)
sources.edition_or_series: 2017 Version, consolidated 29 August 2017; original July 1988 with GG3/01/2017
sources.applicability_caveat: Metadata and purpose verified. Do not substitute geological descriptions for an unverified contractual payment classification.

sources.title: Engineering Survey Practice Guides for Works Projects
sources.publisher: Land and Engineering Survey Board, HKSAR Government
sources.intended_scope: Monitoring survey, Chapter 7; survey-control and records scope as applicable
sources.applicability_caveat: Cover/revision and monitoring chapter inspected selectively. Foreword describes guidance, not universally mandatory rules. Follow adopted requirements and engineer-approved methods.

sources.title: Deep Excavation Design and Construction (GEO Publication No. 1/2023)
sources.intended_scope: ELS monitoring/control context, especially Chapters 9 and 10
sources.applicability_caveat: Relevant I&M passages and contents inspected. ELS-specific technical guidance, not universal design trigger values or a payment schedule; design decisions belong to the engineer.

sources.title: GEO Technical Guidance Note No. 54: Guidelines on Ground Deformation Control Mechanism for Geotechnical Works
sources.intended_scope: Ground deformation control and instrumented ground-improvement context, sections 5.1 and 5.4-5.5
sources.applicability_caveat: Selected passages inspected. Obtain approved project controls and responsible engineer decisions; no default trigger values are supplied by this skill.

sources.title: GEO Technical Guidance Note No. 18: Acceptance of Methods for Quality Control
sources.intended_scope: Acceptance and documented interpretation of new quality-control methods, section 5
sources.applicability_caveat: Selected passage inspected. Does not approve a test method for an individual project; obtain authorised method/acceptance criteria.

sources.title: Port Works Design Manual Part 3: Guide to Design of Reclamation
sources.edition_or_series: Continuously updated e-version June 2023; first published August 2002
sources.applicability_caveat: Cover and monitoring passages inspected. Check later corrigenda; marine context only. Not a universal ground-improvement specification.

sources.title: Port Works Design Manual Part 4: Guide to Design of Seawalls and Breakwaters
sources.edition_or_series: Continuously updated e-version April 2026; first published July 2003
sources.intended_scope: Marine soil-strengthening trials, QA and monitoring, section 7.3
sources.applicability_caveat: Cover and relevant passage inspected. Marine scope and adopted technique must fit; not universal billing or design rules.

scope: Instrumentation and monitoring, instrument-related ground investigation, and ground improvement involving instrumentation.
